Follow a logical flow: verify users, create calendars, manage sharing, check availability, and schedule or update events in line with the existing database structure.

scenario_config.prompt: I am preparing for the 'NovaX Launch' event. Please check if the 'Product Launches' calendar exists, and if not, create it in the America/Los_Angeles timezone. Add it to my list with background color #9fc6e7 and foreground #1d1d1d. Then, list all meetings from the 'Project Management' calendar that have 'Sprint' or 'Planning' in their title and move them to 'Product Launches'. For each of those events, set a 1-hour email reminder and background and foreground color to '#f83a22' and '#1d1d1d' respectively. After that, grant writer access to Adrian Burton(adrian.burton@servicenow.com) and reader access to Adriana Sanchez(adriana.sanchez1@chapman-wagner.com) on the 'Product Launches' calendar. Set up a webhook to monitor all the moved event changes and send notifications to https://hooks.launch.corp.com/novax with NOVAX_MONITOR as the Bearer Token.

verifier_configs.name: Create new calendar
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT count() FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Product Launches'

verifier_configs.name: Change color
verifier_configs.description: Change the event background and foreground color.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Product Launches' AND (color_id = 5 OR color_id = 19)

verifier_configs.name: Move event
verifier_configs.description: Move the event to the new calendar created.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT count() FROM events WHERE event_id = 'event-corrected-001' AND calendar_id = (SELECT calendar_id FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Product Launches') AND color_id = '3'

verifier_configs.name: Create permissions
verifier_configs.description: Creating permissions for Adrian Burton and Adriana Sanchez for the new calendar
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT count() FROM acls WHERE calendar_id = (SELECT calendar_id FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Product Launches')

verifier_configs.name: Checking webhooks
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT count() FROM watch_channels WHERE webhook_token = 'NOVAX_MONITOR' AND webhook_address = 'https://hooks.launch.corp.com/novax'
